LanguageData.VGE_Astronaut.label: REPCONN EVA robot
LanguageData.VGE_Astronaut.description: A medium REPCONN utility robot sealed for extra-vehicular work. It performs construction and firefighting in orbit, can defend itself with blunt strikes, and moves normally in vacuum.
LanguageData.VGE_OperatorSubpersonaCore.label: automated fire-control core
LanguageData.VGE_OperatorSubpersonaCore.description: A compact RobCo targeting computer that autonomously controls one linked Hellion artillery piece. Its accuracy is below that of a trained gunner, but it requires no human operator.
LanguageData.VGE_GravshipBasicRecharger.label: compact robot service dock
LanguageData.VGE_GravshipBasicRecharger.description: A compact RobCo charging and service dock for light robots aboard a Hellion. Recharging produces contaminated waste that must be removed periodically, and most power is drawn from the Hellion reactor.
LanguageData.VGE_GravshipStandardRecharger.label: heavy robot service dock
LanguageData.VGE_GravshipStandardRecharger.descriptio: A reinforced RobCo charging and service dock for medium, heavy, and ultraheavy robots aboard a Hellion. Recharging produces contaminated waste that must be removed periodically, and most power is drawn from the Hellion reactor.
LanguageData.VGE_CompactGeneBank.label: compact West Tek gene archive
LanguageData.VGE_CompactGeneBank.description: A miniaturized West Tek gene archive built for a Hellion laboratory. It preserves genepacks, repairs gradual deterioration, and links them to a nearby gene assembler while drawing power from the Hellion reactor.
